lines: Prof. Oak may not look like much, but he's the authority on Pokémon.
Many Pokémon Trainers hold him in high regard.
Hello there! My name is Oak. People call me the Pokémon Professor!
Recently, there have been sightings of many rare Pokémon species.
I'm talking about Pokémon that have never been seen in Kanto.
I would love to check it out myself, but I'm much too old.
Since I can't do it, I'd like you to go in my place.
It is my invention, the Pokédex!
It is a high-tech encyclopedia that automatically records data on Pokémon you have seen or caught.
To make a complete guide on all the Pokémon in the world...
Get moving! Truly, this is a great undertaking in Pokémon history!

lines: Just like people, Pokémon are living things.
When they get tired, please give them a rest.
Grandpa asked you to run an errand? Gee, that's lazy of him.
It sounds like you had quite the experience out there.
Maybe you should take a quick rest so you can relax.
